observation.command:
cd /workspace && curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "Swagger followed: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4000/api/v1/swagger
SUPER=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)
echo "=== create school ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/v1/school/create-one-school \
  -H "x-super-admin-api-key: $SUPER" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Eckener-Schule Flensburg","slug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n"
